script = '''
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook("uploads/Q3_sales_data.xlsx")
ws = wb.active

# Get headers
headers = [cell.value for cell in ws[1]]
print(f"Headers: {headers}")

# Find relevant column indices
rep_col = None
status_col = None
for i, h in enumerate(headers):
    if h and "rep" in str(h).lower():
        rep_col = i
    if h and ("status" in str(h).lower() or "stage" in str(h).lower() or "result" in str(h).lower()):
        status_col = i

print(f"Rep column index: {rep_col} -> {headers[rep_col] if rep_col is not None else 'NOT FOUND'}")
print(f"Status column index: {status_col} -> {headers[status_col] if status_col is not None else 'NOT FOUND'}")

# Collect all unique reps and statuses for verification
reps = set()
statuses = set()
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True):
    if row[rep_col]:
        reps.add(str(row[rep_col]).strip())
    if row[status_col]:
        statuses.add(str(row[status_col]).strip())

print(f"Unique reps: {reps}")
print(f"Unique statuses: {statuses}")

# Filter James Okafor's won deals
filtered_rows = []
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True):
    rep = str(row[rep_col]).strip() if row[rep_col] else ""
    status = str(row[status_col]).strip().lower() if row[status_col] else ""
    if "james okafor" in rep.lower() and status == "won":
        filtered_rows.append(row)

print(f"\\nFound {len(filtered_rows)} won deals for James Okafor:")
for r in filtered_rows:
    print(r)

# Write filtered results to a new workbook
out_wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
out_ws = out_wb.active
out_ws.title = "James Okafor - Won Deals"

# Style the header
header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", size=11)
header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
thin_border = Border(
    left=Side(style="thin"),
    right=Side(style="thin"),
    top=Side(style="thin"),
    bottom=Side(style="thin"),
)

for col_idx, h in enumerate(headers, 1):
    cell = out_ws.cell(row=1, column=col_idx, value=h)
    cell.font = header_font
    cell.fill = header_fill
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
    cell.border = thin_border

# Write data rows
for row_idx, row_data in enumerate(filtered_rows, 2):
    for col_idx, value in enumerate(row_data, 1):
        cell = out_ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=col_idx, value=value)
        cell.border = thin_border

# Auto-fit column widths
for col in out_ws.columns:
    max_len = 0
    col_letter = col[0].column_letter
    for cell in col:
        if cell.value:
            max_len = max(max_len, len(str(cell.value)))
    out_ws.column_dimensions[col_letter].width = max_len + 3

out_wb.save("output/James_Okafor_Won_Deals.xlsx")
print("\\nFiltered file saved to output/James_Okafor_Won_Deals.xlsx")
'''
